items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: So I stayed with Peter Lynn Hayes at the Sands for the run he had there and then he took me to New York on the Godfrey Hour.

ctx.x: I'm just telling you now. And he brought me back. I was number one on the list for the Bill Robinson Story, I was doing it for 20th Century Fox and he got me a five-week contract with Peter Lynn Hayes and Mary Healy at the Sands Hotel in Las Vegas in the event that I don't pull through with this audition to become the part in the play -- the picture.

So I took the contract, he brought me back and I went with Peter Lind Hayes at the Sands and the had a strike on 20th Century Fox so I didn't get to do the picture. So I stayed with Peter Lynn Hayes at the Sands for the run he had there and then he took me to New York on the Godfrey Hour. So I was with him for two years -- 1957, stayed with him until 1961, then I went with Judy Garland in 1961 at the Met. Then I come back to the -- when I was with Anna Marie Alberghetti to Canada and then I went to Chicago with…
I'm a Friars' Club member, too, now.
